description: S462 Q12 twin — a lambda passed directly to a built-in that calls it synchronously and does not retain it (`.map` on a known array) keeps the narrowing. Compiles clean; clicking renders the mapped text.
rationale: §42.3.5 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a", Q12): "EXCEPT a lambda passed directly to a built-in known to call it synchronously and not retain it"
